contract_assessment.issue_handling_current_code: Corrected from the initial read: actual current selected-neighbor-prevention code at the pinned commit validates full operation/query rosters, requires exact issue geometry for every nonempty residual/conflict/hierarchy operation, returns each nonempty geometry as a veto pointset, and the caller tests each requested center against those pointsets. A nonempty issue can therefore be present while cells away from it pass; the issue itself remains adverse and uncleared. Do not interpret the older additive-gap-repair prose exact-empty wording as current implementation behavior.
contract_assessment.extra_missing_reconstruction: Nonempty missing_reconstruction and extra_reconstruction operations need an exact same-geometry issue entry; they are added to residual pointsets and candidate cells are checked against residual interiors/boundary ties. A matching issue is evidence to preserve the residual, not a reason to repair or ignore it.
contract_assessment.contradictory_and_hierarchy: Nonempty contradictory_land_water_support and hierarchy disagreement pointsets also require exact same-geometry issue entries in this implementation. They enter the pointset checks; they are not rejected solely because nonempty. The original physical issue remains adverse and must stay recorded.
contract_assessment.observed_issue_types: Across nine issue-bearing targets the retained whole-target result has 4 extra_reconstruction, 1 missing_reconstruction, 9 contradictory_land_water_support and 5 L2-outside-L1 issue records. The original diagnostic ran the stock evaluator; those target-level issue labels alone do not establish whether a particular candidate center contacts each issue.
contract_assessment.133_issue_free_subset: The 133 supported cells on 11 issue-free targets are a descriptive, conservative investigation subset—not a requirement and not a positive source-applicability finding. The residual evaluator can admit requested cells on issue-bearing targets when the exact evidence and center tests pass.
contract_assessment.source_and_stable_location: The original record retains its exact source feature ID, owner index and hierarchy binding. The 2023 reform may change a present-day administrative affiliation without automatically invalidating the recorded stable territorial location; however, exact old source-member/owner identity does not alone prove applicability to the selected current baseline. The available official current-name table is insufficient to decide that for the remaining 17 source records.
contract_assessment.positive_source_status: No positive subset is proven by this follow-up. For the 133 clean physical subgroup (or any larger mechanically supported subset), the unresolved factual question is specific source applicability: evidence should establish that each exact source feature continues to represent the same recorded atlas location selected in the current baseline, or identify an actual reassignment/split affecting it. A blanket crosswalk to all modern 42 communes is not required by the original contract; name presence/absence alone is not a substitute for membership evidence.

limits: The name comparison is a name-only join to INSBU Table 1.01, not a legal successor mapping or boundary comparison.

The CENI official page links the 78-page Organic Law PDF, but the accessible text extraction provided zero lines; its annex was not interpreted. Search-index snippets were not treated as evidence of specific owner-to-zone relations.
The prior generic statement that current code requires contradictory/hierarchy pointsets to be empty has been corrected against the inspected immutable code at the pin above.
No source, physical, owner observation or native diagnostic was rerun for this follow-up.
